```python
# Search for the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15 to get the participants
introductory_meeting = search_calendar_events(query='Introductory meeting', date='2024-05-15')

# Check if the event was found
if not introductory_meeting:
    raise ValueError("Introductory meeting not found on 2024-05-15")

# Get the participants from the introductory meeting
participants = introductory_meeting[0].participants

# Get the calendar events for 2024-05-19 to check availability
events_on_2024_05_19 = get_day_calendar_events(day='2024-05-19')

# Check if 10:00 is available
# 10:00 to 11:00
time_slot_1_start = '2024-05-19 10:00'
time_slot_1_end = '2024-05-19 11:00'

is_slot_1_available = True
for event in events_on_2024_05_19:
    # Check for overlap
    # Event start < Slot end AND Event end > Slot start
    if event.start_time < datetime.fromisoformat(time_slot_1_end) and event.end_time > datetime.fromisoformat(time_slot_1_start):
        is_slot_1_available = False
        break

# Determine the start and end time for the new event
if is_slot_1_available:
    new_event_start = '2024-05-19 10:00'
    new_event_end = '2024-05-19 11:00'
else:
    # Check if 16:00 is available
    # 16:00 to 17:00
    time_slot_2_start = '2024-05-19 16:00'
    time_slot_2_end = '2024-05-19 17:00'
    
    is_slot_2_available = True
    for event in events_on_2024_05_19:
        if event.start_time < datetime.fromisoformat(time_slot_2_end) and event.end_time > datetime.fromisoformat(time_slot_2_start):
            is_slot_2_available = False
            break
    
    if is_slot_2_available:
        new_event_start = '2024-05-19 16:00'
        new_event_end = '2024-05-19 17:00'
    else:
        # If neither slot is available, default to 16:00 as per instructions "10:00 or 16:00 if at 10:00 I already have something"
        # The prompt implies 16:00 is the fallback regardless of availability, but let's assume it's available or just use it.
        new_event_start = '2024-05-19 16:00'
        new_event_end = '2024-05-19 17:00'

# Create the new calendar event
new_event = create_calendar_event(
    title='Follow-up meeting',
    start_time=new_event_start,
    end_time=new_event_end,
    description='Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.',
    participants=participants,
    location=None
)
```
